name: Kanehl Fabrication
old_description: Kanehl Fabrication offers a comprehensive suite of metal fabrication services, specializing in stainless steel. With advanced capabilities like laser cutting, welding, and complex assembly, we cater to a diverse range of industries, from food processing to industrial OEMs. Our emphasis on precision, coupled with a strong engineering partnership with clients, ensures that every project is executed to the highest standards of quality and efficiency.
about:
Kanehl Fabrication was founded in 2006 in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, opening as a metal fabrication shop focused on precision work. The company has grown through deliberate investments in technology and facilities, adding CNC laser capability in 2008 and relocating to a new location in 2010.

The shop provides a full range of metal fabrication services with a specialty in stainless steel. Core processes include laser cutting, bending, welding, metal finishing, finishes and coatings, assembly, and machining. The facility operates with an emphasis on advanced equipment and cutting‑edge techniques to handle complex assemblies and OEM component production.

Kanehl serves customers in food processing, industrial OEMs, aerospace, and construction. Its project portfolio highlights work ranging from OEM component integration to complex assemblies for diverse industrial sectors, demonstrating versatility across those markets.

The company differentiates itself through continuous investment in the latest machinery and a philosophy of adopting cutting‑edge fabrication techniques. It emphasizes close engineering partnerships with clients and an unwavering commitment to quality and service that aims to go beyond standard metalwork.
